How do innovation, digital transformation, industrial policy, and green technologies shape sustainable transitions?
:::

## Questions we examine

- Which capabilities enable local participation in green industries?
- What are the ecological and social impacts of emerging technologies?
- How do technology choices affect economic inclusion and resource demand?
